examples.text: Флокены резко снижают статическую и особенно усталостную прочность изделий, поэтому наличие их в готовых изделиях недопустимо.

examples.text: По времени способы назначения разделяются на две категории: статические — распределение выполняется на этапе написания, компиляции или старта программы (до реального начала вычислений); динамические — распределение осуществляется в процессе исполнения.

glosses: Unchanging; that cannot or does not change.

examples.text: It's important to know that the Earth's crust is in no manner a stable and static place.

glosses: Making no progress; stalled, without movement or advancement.
Immobile; fixed in place; having no motion.

examples.text: England were ponderous with ball in hand, their runners static when taking the ball and their lines obvious, while their front row struggled badly in the scrum.

glosses: Computed, created, or allocated before the program starts running, as opposed to at runtime.

examples.text: A further advantage of static type checking is of course computational efficiency, since run time checks are no longer necessary.
A static variable is one whose storage remains allocated for the duration of the entire program. All global variables are static variables.

Despite the term, a static website doesn’t mean one that never changes. Static refers to the fact that the site’s assets—HTML files, graphics, and other downloadable content such as PDF files—are just static files sitting in an S3 bucket.

glosses: Defined for the class itself, as opposed to instances of it; thus shared between all instances and accessible even without an instance.
Interference on a broadcast signal caused by atmospheric disturbances; heard as crackles on radio, or seen as random specks on television.
